$Comment: The game's own Hookshot, a goblin gadget: it reels the player to the block it hits, or a creature to the player, and latches onto the Hook Anchors sold beside it (Hallows_Eve_Offer_Scrap_Hook). For players Trusted with Old Jack, which the gate spells Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack/Honored: Old Jack's ranks keep the library's ids under the names Reputations/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack.json gives them. The Requires block locks it until then; a locked offer still shows on the shelf, so a player can see what to work towards. Named by the item's own keys, written in full (server.items.<Id>.name) so the stall shows the name and line the item shows in the bag.
